narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Jump sizes are two, three, four, six, eight and twelve, so one and twenty four do not count.
<bookmark mark='one'/>But jumps of one land on every square, so Jumpy reaches twenty four after twenty four tiny jumps.
<bookmark mark='leap'/>And one big leap of twenty four lands on the treasure at once.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Both of them count, so Chintu's list is missing two jump sizes.

narration: <bookmark mark='rule'/>A jump size lands on the treasure when it divides the number exactly, and one always works.
<bookmark mark='turn'/>Your turn. Grumpy puts a treasure on nine. Which jump sizes land on it?
